title: Review of c56's prey IXDE on fresh seed 15 (256^2, matched twin) and a 128^2 fuel-cut gate: prey divide to generation 4 only with predators (54 persistent splits vs 0), move (313 vs 2 tracks), and all 46 dissolve within 200 t of a fuel cut with their material kept
summary: Labkit re-run of c52's world.py (the claim's world, defaults) on seed 15 at 256^2, t=12000, K=20, with its matched predator-free twin (pred_on 0), and a global fuel cut (fork_t 6000) against a fed run at 128^2 (70 frames). Prey with predators: 97 persistent tracks, 54 persistent splits, generation 4, merge/split 0.45, 313 moving tracks, 186 bodies at the end; twin: 153 static prey, 0 persistent splits, 2 moving tracks. From t=4000, prey number is 186 vs 164 and prey condensed area 0.086 vs 0.193. Fork: prey 46 -> 2 -> 0 by t=6200, mean prey material 0.288 -> 0.298 (kept), against 45-52 in the fed run; both arms identical to t=6000.

observations.S: rerun/seed15/sheet.png t=0: unstructured noise over the whole domain
observations.I: rerun/seed15/FACTS.md: 97 persistent prey tracks; prey are free round condensates (sheet)
observations.X: xcompare15.png, controls/twin_seed15: prey persistent splits 54 vs 0, moving tracks 313 vs 2, prey number 186 vs 164, condensed area 0.086 vs 0.193 (t>=4000); predators raise prey number, division and motion and cut prey biomass
observations.D: rerun/seed15/FACTS.md: prey 54 persistent splits (K=20), generation 4, merge/split 0.45
observations.E: controls/ffork_seed15_128 vs controls/fed_seed15_128: prey 46 -> 0 within 200 t of the fuel cut, mean prey material 0.288 -> 0.298 (kept); fed 45-52

controls_run.X: controls/twin_seed15 (pred_on 0, same seed, grid, duration and window)
controls_run.E: controls/ffork_seed15_128 (fork_t 6000) vs controls/fed_seed15_128 (same seed, run alongside)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. The fork is global and at 128^2; the per-body cut was not re-run. The prey's division depends on the predators (the twin's prey never divide), so prey D is itself the interaction. Prey material is never made from fuel, so E is not by construction. Prey merge/split is 0.45, below the 50% reticulation cap.
